description: Estimated sugar grams are anchored to the 43 g bar and expected sugar-heavy chocolate formulation. Price is a refined-sugar benchmark proxy, not Hershey invoice cost.
display_note: Modeled estimate; not Hershey proprietary SKU-level cost accounting.

description: Cocoa/chocolate mass allocation is estimated because Hershey does not disclose the exact bill of materials. Benchmark price represents cocoa/chocolate ingredient proxy, not actual contract price.
display_note: Modeled estimate; not Hershey proprietary SKU-level cost accounting.

description: Cocoa butter is modeled separately from cocoa/chocolate because it is a distinct ingredient stream. Weight and price are benchmark assumptions.
display_note: Modeled estimate; not Hershey proprietary SKU-level cost accounting.

description: Milk is modeled as a dairy solids input rather than liquid milk weight. Price is a dairy product benchmark proxy.
display_note: Modeled estimate; not Hershey proprietary SKU-level cost accounting.

description: Skim milk is proxied with nonfat dry milk / dairy solids pricing. Exact ingredient form and quantity are not publicly disclosed.
display_note: Modeled estimate; not Hershey proprietary SKU-level cost accounting.

description: Milk fat is proxied using butterfat/butter-related dairy benchmarks. Exact milk fat quantity is modeled, not disclosed.
display_note: Modeled estimate; not Hershey proprietary SKU-level cost accounting.

description: Soy lecithin is used at very small emulsifier rates. Supplier is unknown and price is a specialty ingredient proxy.
display_note: Modeled estimate; not Hershey proprietary SKU-level cost accounting.

description: PGPR is modeled as a tiny specialty emulsifier/flow-modifier input. Supplier is unknown and price is a specialty ingredient proxy.
display_note: Modeled estimate; not Hershey proprietary SKU-level cost accounting.

description: Natural flavor is modeled as a very small flavor input. Exact composition and supplier are unknown.
display_note: Modeled estimate; not Hershey proprietary SKU-level cost accounting.

description: Packaging includes primary wrapper plus allocated paperboard/case packaging. Exact wrapper supplier and exact SKU packaging cost are not public.
display_note: Allocation estimate; not Hershey proprietary SKU-level cost accounting.

description: Manufacturing conversion includes labor, utilities, overhead, maintenance, depreciation, and plant operations allocation. This is a modeled public-information allocation, not Hershey internal SKU accounting.
display_note: Allocation estimate; not Hershey proprietary SKU-level cost accounting.

description: Storage and warehousing are allocated using public logistics/warehousing benchmark context. Exact SKU storage cost is not public.
display_note: Allocation estimate; not Hershey proprietary SKU-level cost accounting.

description: Freight is allocated using trucking/diesel/logistics benchmark context. Exact route cost for the 1.55 oz SKU is not public.
display_note: Allocation estimate; not Hershey proprietary SKU-level cost accounting.

description: Retail price pages were collected, but exact shelf prices are not entered into the cost model until final visual verification. This prevents using screenshot/PDF prices incorrectly.
display_note: Retail price evidence is collected but not numerically used until visual verification.
